root_cause: The existing social-learning-evaluate used selectSnapshotForWindow on ALL post snapshots without checking dataQuality. Newly reconciled Windsor LinkedIn company source is explicitly OBSERVED_PARTIAL_SCOPE by provider-date rather than cumulative age, and a retrieval timestamp near a due window might spuriously generate an evaluation or even PROVEN learning.

observed_evidence.affected_metrics: LinkedIn provider-day observations with actual impressions, but not verified cumulative 24/48/72-hour outcomes

fix: Retain exact hourly selection, but only pass OBSERVED/PROVIDER_OBSERVED original time-window snapshots to evaluation. Partial-scope evidence generates a typed obligation rather than an invented causal score. Existing tests mark truly observed fixtures OBSERVED and new regression enforces both bounds.
prevention_rule: No provider-date, unlinked, partial-scope or inferred marketing source may be promoted to causal 24/48/72h learning merely because it has an extraction timestamp. Next-post hypotheses may use partial daily analytics independently under their own scope, never a false experiment winner.
terminal_rule: Protected exact SHA checks and Netlify production source parity, only then eligible real 24/48/72-hour brand evaluations read back; no numeric customer-conversion claim without independently attributed order.
